bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
echo CVD_HOST_READ_BEGIN
printf 'CWD='; pwd
printf 'CHECKOUT_SHA='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'CHECKOUT_BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
printf 'TARGET_SOURCE_PRESENT='; if test -f src/sales/pgStarsLedger.mjs; then echo YES; else echo NO; fi
printf 'UNIFIED_SOURCE_PRESENT='; if test -f src/sales/pgUnifiedStarsSales.mjs; then echo YES; else echo NO; fi
printf 'CHECKOUT_DIRTY='; if test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; then echo NO; else echo YES; fi
echo CVD_CONTAINER_NAMES_BEGIN
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei 'create.*vdo|video.*bot|postgres' || true
echo CVD_CONTAINER_NAMES_END
echo CVD_HOST_READ_END
